description: Mid-level backend engineer with activity-based bullets, no measurable outcomes, and minimal ownership language. Heavy task descriptions with no results.

responsibilities: Design and develop scalable backend systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products.
Identify areas for process improvements and implement changes.
requirements: 5+ years of experience in software engineering.
Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals.

bullets: Designed and developed a real-time analytics system using Node.js and MongoDB.
Worked with the DevOps team to improve deployment efficiency by 30%.
Participated in code reviews and provided feedback to colleagues.
Developed a data processing pipeline using Apache Beam and Google Cloud Storage.
Collaborated with the QA team to identify and resolve issues in a timely manner.
Contributed to the development of a microservices architecture.

evalCriteria: Should detect a lack of measurable outcomes and results in the résumé bullets.
Should flag the heavy use of task descriptions without any supporting evidence or outcomes.
Should rate Technical Capability as weak due to the absence of significant technical achievements.
Should identify the need for more ownership language and specific examples of impact.
Should ask evidence recovery questions about measurable outcomes, results, and ownership in the résumé.
